decisions.reason: A classic lever handle fits the firm's core hardware portfolio, carries little extra cost, and there is no sign of a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
A handle family launched only a year ago has not had time to be judged against the aspiration level, and a large firm's slack allows it to carry the family while sales build up.
Design handles are inexpensive to keep in the range, and with no evidence of underperformance management would not drop this one after one year.
Like C, this design handle has low carrying costs and no reported shortfall, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
A lever handle family is a core-portfolio investment that a large firm with slack keeps beyond its first year.
The firm promoted the L700 electronic access system for its unique light technology, a strategic innovation where an early drop is unlikely while results are still uncertain and slack is available.
